title: “When Relationships Pull You Away from God”
paragraphs: “When Relationships Pull You Away from God”
Some relationships feel right—but quietly pull you away from God.
This powerful, convicting book exposes how emotional attachment, compromise, and spiritual misalignment can weaken your faith without you realizing it.
“When Relationships Pull You Away from God” will help you:

Discern unhealthy relationships
Recognize spiritual drift early
Break free from emotional bondage
Choose obedience over attachment
Restore your intimacy with God
This is not just about relationships.
It’s about who truly has your heart.
If this message convicted you, you are not alone.
